item.title: Engineering Trends in 2026
item.description: In this special 100th episode of Inside Electronics, Electronic Design’s editors discuss what’s in store for the industry this coming year, from processing hardware to advances in wide-bandgap semiconductor technology.

item.title: Bridging the Gap to Chiplet Interoperability
item.description: The move to multi-die integration brings both promise and complexity. Scalable interconnects and automation are emerging as key enablers of future designs.

item.title: Convert High Voltages Using a Transformer-Less Buck Controller
item.description: High-voltage buck controllers, which offer the beauty of a design without the cost and difficulty of using a transformer, enhance power-conversion efficiency and enable high output voltages.

item.title: Tag-Teaming Engineers Week with My Narcissistic AI Girlfriend “Perplexity”
item.description: Andy finds himself in the quandary of needing to cover DesignCon in the Bay Area and to cover Engineers Week and thus is forced to resort to desperate measures...AI.

item.title: Get the Fork Outta There: DesignCon’s Exhibits Now Open
item.description: DesignCon 2026 is running from February 24-26, 2026, at the Santa Clara Convention Center. Andy snuck onto the closed exhibit floor to snap pics as booths were being assembled.

item.title: Tariff Refund: Chase It, or Chalk It Up?
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court's recent ruling on a core element of President Trump's tariff strategies has opened the door for thousands of businesses to file for refunds.

item.title: Reflecting on the 2026 Chiplet Summit
item.description: Editor Bill Wong’s observations from the recent 2026 Chiplet Summit.

item.title: The Future Favors UFS for High-Performance Embedded Flash
item.description: Flash memory is evolving fast. As demands for speed, scalability, and efficiency rise, the industry standard is shifting from eMMC to UFS.

item.title: GaN Powers Up High-Efficiency Motor Joints in Humanoid Robots
item.description: Texas Instruments is developing GaN power devices to enable more compact and efficient motor joints for humanoid robots.

item.title: Real-Time Signal-Integrity Analysis on the 7 Series Oscilloscope
item.description: Tektronix’s 7 Series oscilloscope becomes a powerful signal-integrity tool where signal conditioning and integrity analysis can be easily performed on an advanced GUI.
